newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea firms buy corn, tender soymeal, rapemeal.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea firms buy corn, tender soymeal, rapemeal.

text.p: The Korean Feed Association (KFA) is to tender for 40,000 tonnes of soymeal and 5,000 tonnes of rapemeal on Tuesday, trade sources said on Friday.
The tender is in two positions:
1. 20,000 tonnes soymeal arrival April 20 at Inchon.
2. 20,000 tonnes soymeal and 5,000 tonnes rapemeal arrival April 20 at Ulsan or Kunsan.
The sources added that a South Korean trader had also bought 12,000 tonnes of Chinese corn through Tradi-Grain in private negotiation at $143.50 a tonne C&F.
They said this takes the total of South Korean Chinese corn purchases to 84,000 tonnes in the past week.
